$comment: Example for omarchy. Task 1 writes the real .qa/unified-supervisor.json on each remote host from discovered binaries/ports/host ids with apply_patch. Every path must be absolute and task-owned; production roots such as ~/.ferryx or any hub.sqlite are refused. slackChannel stays null until a QA channel is approved in the execution session. The admission scenario needs no extra field: it builds its fixture git project, hub port (FERRYX_HUB_TRACKER_ADDR on a free loopback port), workspace and POSIX worker shell inside the run root; git must be on PATH.
